Alma en Canto is
a singing circle born from our community

Every Thursday at Almaíso
we gather to sing, listen and connect

you are warmly welcome to join us, see how in the next story✨
Tomorrow, we gather under the full moon Will you be there? 🥰

For now, we don’t hold regular weekly classes, but it’s definitely on our future plans. 

We do gather as a community,
and from time to time, we open the space through Alma en Canto, our single circle, 
which we share here on Instagram when it’s happening. You are always welcome to join us there.

And slowly, new forms are already taking shape 🥰

We work closely with a network of chefs
who understand the rhythm of this place
and the needs of each gathering.
We are happy to connect you with them.

And as the project continues to grow,
our own kitchen will open later this year ✨
